title: Punched in the Dicks Sporting Goods

observed_trades.setup: Bitcoin '4B / 4B minus' setup bought 'picture perfect'; worked right from the jump with no headache to hold.
observed_trades.quote: if you bought IBIT uh as of last Wednesday, you're sitting in the driver's seat. I bought it on Monday
observed_trades.notes: Which Monday is ambiguous: session is Tuesday 2026-08-25, so 'Monday' could be 2026-08-24 (yesterday) or 2026-08-17. Context ('as of last Wednesday', 'Wednesday's push', already trimmed) favours 2026-08-17; fill_date_stated left blank rather than guessed.

observed_trades.setup: Trimmed a piece into strength and is now hands-off, letting it tighten for possible adds.
observed_trades.quote: I happen to be in tune with Bitcoin and the 4B setup, 4B minus setup, and I got in right, and it worked well, and I trimmed a piece
observed_trades.notes: Trim date not given. Vehicle is IBIT per 04:27.

observed_trades.setup: Bought Dell on the pullback up against the 50-day; it did not close well.
observed_trades.quote: Uh yesterday, I went after Dell and it just didn't close well enough for me to be able to keep.
observed_trades.notes: It gapped up and ripped the next day without him.

observed_trades.setup: Sold into the close rather than hold slight red overnight.
observed_trades.quote: I I I bought some Dell in here and it just wasn't closing well. So, I was like, all right, I'll I'll I'll watch it tomorrow, right? I'm not going to hold, you know, slight red overnight
observed_trades.notes: 'yesterday' is in the adjacent sentence. In hindsight he says he could have cut half and left the stop at the low (17:07).

observed_trades.setup: MongoDB pulling into the 20-day; bought after a morning washout on the 5-minute opening range break.
observed_trades.entry_basis: morning washout, then 5-minute opening range break off the 20-day
observed_trades.quote: I bought some MDB. I thought MDB, you know, into the 20 day today looked pretty damn good
MDB looks pretty good. It's bouncing off the 20. Smoked.
observed_trades.notes: He does not say 'stopped'; exit inferred from 'Smoked' and the later 'you're back in at 401'.

observed_trades.setup: Second attempt: washout of the 20-day / prior day low and the reclaim.
observed_trades.entry_basis: washout of the 20-day and prior day low, then the reclaim
observed_trades.quote: you buy the wash out of the 20 day a prior day low and then the reclaim and you're back in at 401.
observed_trades.notes: Second-person narration anchored by 'I bought some MDB' (09:35).

observed_trades.setup: Did not close well; would not carry it overnight with no cushion.
observed_trades.quote: And then it just doesn't close like anything and then you're going into the overnight session with absolutely no cushion. Um yeah, no. Uh definitely not.
observed_trades.notes: Second-person narration; 'Um yeah, no. Uh definitely not' read as not holding overnight.
